newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada trade minister collapses, but health is good.
newsitem.headline: Canada trade minister collapses, but health is good.

text.p: Canadian Trade Minister Art Eggleton collapsed at a meeting on Tuesday and was taken to a hospital, but an official said later he was in good health and would leave Tuesday night for a conference in Manila.
"The last thing I heard was he's still going to Manila," Eggleton's spokeswoman Elaine McArdle told Reuters by telephone from Ottawa. "His health is great. It doesn't appear that anything is broken."
Speakers had just finished addressing a luncheon audience of businessmen and trade officials at a Toronto hotel when Eggleton, 53, tripped as he got up to leave the head table.
"There was a gap in the floorboards and he went right through them," McArdle said.

Other dignitaries helped Eggleton, pale and shaky, to a chair where he waited with his head resting on a table until ambulance attendants arrived. The attendants strapped on an oxygen mask and carried Eggleton out on a stretcher.
Witnesses said he twisted his ankle as he fell and landed on his knee.

Eggleton was scheduled to leave for Manila on Tuesday night for the Asia Pacific Economic Co-operation (APEC) annual meeting and summit. He was scheduled to accompany Prime Minister Jean Chretien to China and Japan afterwards.
